name: History Extended Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The program requires 18 units in 100 and 200 division courses and 15 or 16 units in 300 and 400 division, with at least four units in each division.

sections.note:
To enter the program, students must contact the departmental advisor ( histadv@sfu.ca ).
A history extended minor can be added at any time.
Students in history programs have the option of taking concentrations to enhance their programs.
Concentration in Middle Eastern and Islamic History
Concentration in British History and Irish History
Concentration in Early Modern World History
